extracted.intended_audience: new principal investigators and academic researchers thinking about NIH/major grant timing
extracted.subtask_description: Advice for early-career PIs on when to submit a second major grant (e.g., a second R01) relative to their first award/renewal, including tactical planning for overlapping awards and project diversification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing of second major grant submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not wait for the first renewal before submitting a second major grant. "In short, no." The days of counting on the NIH renewal application being funded, even given great productivity, are over.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tactically, submit the second major grant early enough to create overlap with the first award; do not assume renewal funds will arrive. Plan submission schedules so awards overlap to avoid gaps in funding continuity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure overlapping awards for continuity
rubrics_metrics.description: You need overlapping awards just to ensure continuity of a one-R01 sized lab.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for staggered or overlapping funding periods so that loss/delay of one award doesn't interrupt lab operations. Treat overlap as tactical insurance rather than optional redundancy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversify projects/portfolio
rubrics_metrics.description: It's really hard to make it as a single grant lab in the long term; you need diversity of projects because one might run into doldrums for reasons outside of your control.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pursue multiple, distinct projects that can support independent funding lines. Use project diversity to reduce vulnerability to topic-specific setbacks or changing funding priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity expectation for new PIs (ability to hold two major awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: New PIs can handle the load of two major projects; examples exist of scientists who got two major awards early (first 2–3 years) and did fine. The author cannot recall scientists who failed because they had two R01s early, though exceptions may exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not avoid applying for additional major grants out of fear that you cannot manage the work; evaluate lab management and staffing plans to support parallel projects and rely on institutional support where needed.
